ignoreRequestsWithFalsyContextVars.description:
Configuration to set whether or not components of a certain {@link UiSdlRoute#targetModuleName} should
send requests while having `undefined` values for contextVars.

Example:
{ SDLDemo: true, SDL: false }

In this case, every component whose IDs start with `SDLDemo` (for example SDLDemo.ExampleComponent) will
only allow network requests due to contextVar resolution when the resolved value is not `undefined`.
On the other hand, components that start with `SDL` will make the network requests every time that contextVars
re-resolve, regardless of the values.
